title: Playground Moonshine JFK transcription
description: Transcribes the bundled JFK sample with Moonshine small streaming through the ASR benchmark screen and asserts the transcript text and timings.

proofTargets.claim: The benchmark screen starts from sample mode with Moonshine small streaming, the JFK sample and no results.
Moonshine transcribes the JFK sample to the known sentence.
The run reports model init and recognition times for the before/after comparison.

status.intent: Read the starting route so teardown can restore it.

benchmark-screen-ready.intent: Open the ASR benchmark screen with its model and run controls visible.

select-sample-mode.intent: Switch the benchmark to sample-file mode.

select-model.intent: Select the Moonshine small streaming English model.

select-sample.intent: Select the bundled JFK speech sample.

clear-results.intent: Clear earlier benchmark results so the next result comes from this run.

read-start-state.intent: Wait for the cleared sample-mode selection to reach the page state.

assert-start-state.intent: Verify the run starts with Moonshine small, the JFK sample and an empty result list.

prepare-model.intent: Download or locate the Moonshine small model files.

wait-model-ready.intent: Wait until the selected Moonshine model is on disk.

run-sample.intent: Transcribe the JFK sample with Moonshine.

wait-result.intent: Wait for the Moonshine result to appear on screen.

all.value: [Aa]sk not\W+[Ww]hat your country can do for you
[Aa]sk what you can do for your country

assert-transcript.intent: Verify the transcript holds the known JFK sentence.

assert-timing.intent: Verify the result reports model init and recognition times.

reveal-result.expression: (() => { if (typeof document !== "undefined") { const button = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid=\"asr-benchmark-clear-results\"]")].find(element => element.offsetParent !== null); for (let node = button; node; node = node.parentElement) { if (node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight + 1 && /(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(node).overflowY)) { node.scrollTop = node.scrollHeight; return JSON.stringify({ scrolled: "dom" }) } } return JSON.stringify({ scrolled: null }) } let fiber = globalThis.__AGENTIC__?.findFiberByTestId?.("asr-benchmark-clear-results"); while (fiber) { const node = fiber.stateNode; if (node && typeof node.scrollToEnd === "function") { node.scrollToEnd({ animated: false }); return JSON.stringify({ scrolled: "native" }) } fiber = fiber.return } return JSON.stringify({ scrolled: null }) })()
reveal-result.intent: Scroll the benchmark screen to the result card holding the transcript.

settle-result.intent: Let the result card render before capturing it.

capture-result.intent: Preserve the benchmark screen showing the Moonshine transcript.

restore-results.intent: Clear the benchmark result added by this run.
